muliebrity.definition:
n the state of being an adult woman
n the trait of behaving in ways considered typical for women
muliebrity.translation:
n. 女子的身份
[医] 女子特性, 女性; 男子女征

mulier.definition:
n. A woman.
n. Lawful issue born in wedlock, in distinction from an elder
   brother born of the same parents before their marriage; a lawful son.
n. A woman; a wife; a mother.
mulier.translation: [法] 女子, 妇人, 妻子

mulierty.definition:
n. Condition of being a mulier; position of one born in
   lawful wedlock.

mulish.definition: s unreasonably rigid in the face of argument or entreaty or attack
mulish.translation: a. 似骡的, 执拗的, 顽固的

mulishly.definition: r in a stubborn unregenerate manner

mulishness.definition: n. the trait of being difficult to handle or overcome

mulitiple lymphadenoma.translation: [医] 多发性淋巴瘤, 何杰金氏病
